name: Cookifi – GDPR/CCPA Compliant Cookie Banner with Consent Mode & Geo Targeting
author: cookifi

sections.description:
Cookifi is a comprehensive consent management platform that helps you comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations. This plugin makes it easy to integrate the Cookifi consent dialog into your WordPress website.

Features

  • Easy Integration – Simple setup with just your API key
  • GDPR Compliant – Full compliance with European privacy regulations
  • CCPA Ready – Support for California privacy laws
  • Customizable – Configure your consent dialog through the Cookifi dashboard
  • Debug Mode – Test your implementation with debug options
  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on site performance
  • Auto-Updates – The consent dialog updates automatically without plugin updates

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for a free account at admin.cooki.fi
  3. Get your API key from the Cookifi dashboard
  4. Enter your API key in the plugin settings
  5. That’s it! The consent dialog will appear on your website

Why Choose Cookifi?

  • User-Friendly – Easy setup and management
  • Comprehensive – Covers multiple privacy regulations
  • Transparent – Clear consent tracking and reporting
  • Reliable – Enterprise-grade infrastructure
  • Support – Dedicated customer support team

Get Started

Don’t have a Cookifi account yet? Sign up for free and get your API key to start managing consent on your WordPress site.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the Cookifi service at lib.cooki.fi to load the consent management dialog. When the plugin is active with a valid API key, it will:

  • Load the Cookifi script from https://lib.cooki.fi
  • Send visitor consent choices to Cookifi servers
  • Store consent preferences according to your Cookifi configuration

For more information about data processing, please review the Cookifi Privacy Policy at https://cooki.fi/privacy.

External Services

This plugin relies on the Cookifi service:

  • Service URL: https://lib.cooki.fi
  • Website: https://cooki.fi
  • Privacy Policy: https://cooki.fi/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://cooki.fi/terms

The plugin loads JavaScript from lib.cooki.fi to display the consent management dialog on your website.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Cookifi”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Settings > Cookifi
  2. Sign up at admin.cooki.fi to get your API key
  3. Enter your API key in the plugin settings
  4. Save your settings
  5. Visit your website to see the consent dialog
sections.faq:
Do I need a Cookifi account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need to create a free account at admin.cooki.fi to get your API key.

Is Cookifi free?

Cookifi is not free but aims to be affordable and transparent. Visit cooki.fi for pricing details.

How do I customize the consent dialog?

You can customize the appearance and behavior of your consent dialog through the Cookifi dashboard at admin.cooki.fi.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, Cookifi is designed to help you comply with GDPR and other privacy regulations. However, you should consult with legal counsel to ensure your specific implementation meets all requirements.

What is Debug Mode?

Debug Mode shows additional information about the consent dialog, which is useful for testing and troubleshooting. It should be disabled on production sites.

What is Hidden Mode?

Hidden Mode prevents the consent dialog from appearing on your site. This is useful for testing the integration without showing the dialog to visitors.

Where can I get support?

For plugin-related issues, please use the WordPress.org support forum. For Cookifi platform support, visit cooki.fi or contact us through your dashboard.

How do I uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin from the WordPress admin panel. All plugin settings will be removed automatically.
